description: Elections: notices by the Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (IEBC), the Registrar of Political Parties and the courts about elections - voter registration, returning officers, polling and tallying centres, candidates, results, by-elections, election petitions and political party registration.

election.description: Which election, e.g. 'General Election, 9 August 2022' or 'Kiambu Senator by-election'.

election_date.description: Date of the election, as printed.

electoral_level.description: Level of the elective post, if one is named.

county.description: County, if named. MUST be one of the 47 canonical names in geography.json.

constituency.description: Constituency, if named. Validate against geography.json.

ward.description: Ward, if named. Validate against geography.json.

persons.description: People named in the notice or its schedule.

political_party.description: Party name, for Political Parties Act notices.

issuing_authority.description: e.g. IEBC Chairperson, Registrar of Political Parties, Chief Justice.

legal_basis.description: Provision relied on, e.g. 'Article 88 (4) of the Constitution; section 4 of the IEBC Act'.

deadline.description: Any date by which the public must act (objections, claims), as printed.
